cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Before entering a highway, avoid mistaking the exit ramp for the entrance; watch?
cards.back: Before entering a highway, avoid mistaking the exit ramp for the entrance; watch ONE WAY, WRONG WAY and DO NOT ENTER signs.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: A green HIGHWAY ENTRANCE sign may identify an entrance?
cards.back: A green HIGHWAY ENTRANCE sign may identify an entrance ramp, but is not always present.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: A white edge line on the right and yellow on the left?
cards.back: A white edge line on the right and yellow on the left indicate the proper direction of travel on the ramp.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: In a shared weaving lane, an entering driver?
cards.back: In a shared weaving lane, an entering driver yields to the exiting driver.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Use an acceleration lane to build toward traffic speed, checking the side?
cards.back: Use an acceleration lane to build toward traffic speed, checking the side mirror and looking over the shoulder for a gap.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Move into the exit lane early and slow?
cards.back: Move into the exit lane early and slow only after entering that lane.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: If the exit is missed, use the next exit rather than stopping,?
cards.back: If the exit is missed, use the next exit rather than stopping, reversing, crossing multiple lanes suddenly or crossing the median.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Exit-ramp warning signs indicate the?
cards.back: Exit-ramp warning signs indicate the maximum safe ramp speed.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: At sixty-five miles per hour, a vehicle covers?
cards.back: At sixty-five miles per hour, a vehicle covers almost one hundred feet per second.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: When passing on a highway, change only one lane at a?
cards.back: When passing on a highway, change only one lane at a time and signal each lane change well ahead.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: A through driver may help a highway entrant by changing lanes?
cards.back: A through driver may help a highway entrant by changing lanes courteously, but must first verify space is clear.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Highway hypnosis develops when prolonged staring replaces scanning?
cards.back: Highway hypnosis develops when prolonged staring replaces scanning ahead, behind and around the vehicle.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Along a curb, park as close as possible and?
cards.back: Along a curb, park as close as possible and no farther than twelve inches away.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Without a curb, park as far off?
cards.back: Without a curb, park as far off the roadway as possible.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: When roadway parking is necessary, use hazard flashers, allow passing room and remain?
cards.back: When roadway parking is necessary, use hazard flashers, allow passing room and remain visible for at least five hundred feet in both directions.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Park facing the direction of traffic and?
cards.back: Park facing the direction of traffic and secure the vehicle against movement.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: When parking, set the parking brake and select Park for an?
cards.back: When parking, set the parking brake and select Park for an automatic transmission, or Reverse or First for a manual.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: For downhill parking with a curb, turn?
cards.back: For downhill parking with a curb, turn the wheels fully right.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: For uphill parking with a curb,?
cards.back: For uphill parking with a curb, turn the wheels left.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: On a hill without a curb, point the wheels?
cards.back: On a hill without a curb, point the wheels right whether facing uphill or downhill.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Unless an emergency or police direction requires otherwise, do not double?
cards.back: Unless an emergency or police direction requires otherwise, do not double park beside a stopped or parked roadside vehicle.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or?
cards.back: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park on a sidewalk, crosswalk or within an intersection.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or?
cards.back: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park along or opposite road excavation or work areas.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park on?
cards.back: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park on a bridge, elevated structure or in a highway tunnel.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park on railroad tracks?
cards.back: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park on railroad tracks or within fifty feet of the nearest rail at a crossing.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand?
cards.back: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park between divided-highway roadways, including crossovers.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Except for emergencies or police direction, obey official?
cards.back: Except for emergencies or police direction, obey official signs prohibiting stopping or parking.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or?
cards.back: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park in front of a public or private driveway.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or?
cards.back: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park within fifteen feet of a fire hydrant.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or?
cards.back: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park within twenty feet of an intersection crosswalk.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park within thirty feet?
cards.back: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park within thirty feet of a roadside flashing signal, stop sign, yield sign or traffic-control device.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or?
cards.back: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park within twenty feet of a fire-station driveway entrance.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or?
cards.back: Except for emergencies or police direction, do not stop, stand or park where a streetcar's movement would be blocked.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: On a limited-access highway, stopping, standing and parking are prohibited unless an?
cards.back: On a limited-access highway, stopping, standing and parking are prohibited unless an emergency, police direction or official traffic-control device allows them.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: To parallel park at a right curb, begin beside the vehicle?
cards.back: To parallel park at a right curb, begin beside the vehicle ahead, level with it and two feet away.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Begin backing slowly toward the rear vehicle with?
cards.back: Begin backing slowly toward the rear vehicle with the wheels turned sharply right.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: As the front door passes the leading vehicle's rear bumper,?
cards.back: As the front door passes the leading vehicle's rear bumper, straighten the wheels and continue backing straight.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Once clear of the front vehicle, steer sharply left and?
cards.back: Once clear of the front vehicle, steer sharply left and continue backing slowly toward the rear vehicle.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Finish the parallel park by steering sharply right and?
cards.back: Finish the parallel park by steering sharply right and pulling forward toward the space's center.

cards.front: Which words finish this handbook guidance: Before leaving the vehicle, turn the engine off, remove the key and?
cards.back: Before leaving the vehicle, turn the engine off, remove the key and lock the doors, checking rear traffic before stepping out.
